evidence.quote: entered into as of February 15, 2024 (the “Effective Date”)
LICENSE AND SUBLICENSE AGREEMENT
by Qualigen Therapeutics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“QLGN”)
Pan-RAS Holdings, Inc., a New York corporation (“Pan-RAS”)
a worldwide, exclusive license under the QLGN RAS Technology
a worldwide, exclusive (even as to QLGN) Sublicense under all of QLGN’s License Agreement licensee rights under the Licensed Patents and the Licensed Methods
a worldwide, non-exclusive Sublicense under all of QLGN’s License Agreement licensee rights under the Licensed Technical Knowledge
Pan-RAS shall pay to QLGN $1,000,000 in cash within 30 calendar days after the Effective Date
which deadline date may be extended by consent of QLGN
Pan-RAS shall pay to ULRF, as and when required by the License Agreement to be paid by QLGN to ULRF, all milestone payments required by the License Agreement to be paid by QLGN to ULRF.
all running-royalty (“Royalty”) and minimum-royalty (“Annual Minimum”) payments required by the License Agreement to be paid by QLGN to ULRF
has been provided to Pan-RAS prior to the Effective Date
royalties equal to 1.0% of Net Sales and Licensed Services
on a semiannual basis (at the same times as Royalty payments are required by the License Agreement to be paid by QLGN to ULRF)
all Patent Costs required by Sections 9.2(b) and 9.2(c) of the License Agreement to be paid by QLGN to ULRF
at the lower of 1.5% per month or the highest rate permitted under Applicable Law
Pan-RAS shall not be required to make any Non-Royalty Sublicense Income percentage payment to ULRF in respect of establishing Pan-RAS as a Sublicensee pursuant to this Agreement
100% of any amount of money owing from Pan-RAS to QLGN
The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue until terminated as provided herein.
shall be paid to ULRF or QLGN free and clear of all foreign taxes
“Closing Date” means the date on which Pan-RAS pays QLGN the Upfront Fee
as amended by Amendment 1 dated March 17, 2021, and by Amendment 2 dated June 15, 2023
diligence milestones identified in Section 4.2 of and Exhibit C of the License Agreement
commercialization of Licensed Products to generate Net Sales
Pan-RAS shall make any and all payments pursuant to Article 4 and Article 8 in accordance with the terms thereof
If Pan-RAS terminates this Agreement pursuant to Section 9.2, 9.3 or 9.4
paid in United States Dollars (USD) by wire transfer
such sums shall be for Pan-RAS’ benefit rather than for QLGN’s benefit
comply with the obligations of “Licensee” under Sections 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 of the License Agreement
Pan-RAS may terminate this Agreement at any time prior to the 30th day after the Effective Date
covering the composition of matter or use of RAS compounds and drugs
to be executed and delivered so as to be effective on the date first set forth above

open_issues.description: 'Net Sales', 'Licensed Services', 'Licensed Products', 'Licensed Patents' and 'Licensed Methods' are not defined in this chunk. Section 1 says capitalized terms take their meanings from the ULRF License Agreement, which is not supplied. The royalty base for the 1.0% rate cannot be verified.

The ULRF running royalty, Annual Minimum, milestone payments and Patent Costs that Pan-RAS passes through are set in the ULRF License Agreement and a schedule 'provided to Pan-RAS prior to the Effective Date'. Neither is in the supplied text, so the rates and amounts are unknown.

The Non-Royalty Sublicense Income percentage owed to ULRF is referenced but not stated. Only a waiver for establishing Pan-RAS as Sublicensee is given. Any sublicensing receipt economics for later sublicenses by Pan-RAS are not addressed in this chunk.

The ULRF License Agreement was amended by Amendment 1 (March 17, 2021) and Amendment 2 (June 15, 2023) and novated March 1, 2021. Those documents were not reviewed and may change the pass-through economics. Amendments to this Agreement were not checked.

It is unclear whether the 1.0% on 'Net Sales and Licensed Services' applies to Pan-RAS sales only or also to sublicensee sales, and no royalty term or expiry is stated. No geographic or product limits on the royalty are stated.
Pan-RAS is described as a New York corporation in the preamble but as a Delaware limited liability company in Section 6.3. This does not change the economics but affects party identification.

This is chunk 1 of 2. Chunk 2 was not read here, so any schedules, exhibits, redactions or other economic terms there, including a possible Net Sales definition, must be reconciled against c1-t01, c1-t02, c1-t03 and c1-p01 to c1-p05.
The agreement execution date is not separately stated; only the Effective Date is. The current operative status of this historical SEC filing is not established.
